falsifier: Only a causally changed ETH mechanism with a new identity and prospectively positive after-cost evidence across multiple windows would update this rejection; it would be a new hypothesis, not a promotion of this revision.
limitations: The final 60-day block was previously opened and is descriptive rather than newly sealed.
